Spanish Minor

Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences

Requirements

The Spanish minor requires 20 units of course work in Spanish at the 200 level or above, including SPAN 220 and SPAN 300, with at least 12 units completed in residence. Courses must be taken for a letter grade and passed with a C or better.

  • SPAN 220 Spanish III (4 units)
  • SPAN 300 Advanced Grammar and Composition (4 units)
  • Three additional upper-division SPAN courses (12 units)
